audit.why: Early is TF-favored (Ryze pre-item is weak, immobile), mid is TF's roam window, late flips to stacked Ryze — page and 53.94% WR over 2586 games agree.
Spikes present and grounded: TF pre-item poke, Destiny at 6, Ryze first item + Tear flip, stacked Ryze late. Content spikes[0..3] complete.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers; the root mechanic was understated — Rune Prison only roots if Flux is applied first, otherwise it slows.
audit.why: Kit text: W 'If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted', cd 11/10.5/10/9.5/9, range 615; E cd 3.5-2.5, resets Q. Both his Q and E are projectiles; TF has nothing that blocks them, so no interaction to claim there.
audit.corrected: Rune Prison is a slow unless Flux (E) landed first — the E-tag is the real tell; W cd 11s rank 1, 615 range; his E is 3.5s and resets Overload.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two copy-paste-bleed bullets (dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d) and singular 'Wild Card' in whys[2].
audit.why: lintFindings + suspectNames; TF Q is Wild Cards.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison (Root): matchup-defining — Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W gold card has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Ryze Rune Prison (Root): matchup-defining — 11s cooldown at rank 1, 9s max, 615 range; it only roots if Flux tagged you first — the EQ chain follows. His E is 3.5s and resets Q. Your W gold card has one job: the moment it goes wrong. The R: the moment it goes right.

edits.before: Lock gold off-screen, walk up once, card-auto-Q, and leave — one stun-chunk per cycle is all the lane asks of you.
edits.after: Rune Prison is 615 range on an 11s cooldown — hold W until he steps into it and gold-card the engage, never open with it.

edits.before: Cycling cards inside his engage range for stacked-deck greed — TF dies in exactly one mistimed auto-walk per game; don't pre-book it.
edits.after: Post-6 Ryze cannot follow Destiny — every minute spent trading mid is a bot-lane kill you declined; go take the map's money.

edits.before: Twisted Fate - your Wild Card poke out-ranges his pre-combo damage while he's still item-starved.
edits.after: Twisted Fate - your Wild Cards poke out-ranges his pre-combo damage while he's still item-starved.

edits.before: Q-farm from range and concede the duel question entirely — your level 1 is a wallet, not a weapon.
edits.after: Ryze level 1 is among the game's weakest — no mobility, feeble solo Q; Wild Cards and autos win it.

edits.before: Full kit: stacked-deck autos plus card cycling is a real short trade — but your game is the clock, not the lane.
edits.after: Full kit: your Wild Cards out-range his pre-Flux poke while he's item-starved — the stacked-deck trades are yours.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q the wave, lock cards on cooldown, and watch side lanes like they're your KDA.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — you shove and out-poke a Ryze who can't fight back or leave the lane at levels 4-5.
